summary: UI enhancement for the Cleaned Notes panel: rebuild action section with Copy/Clear/Download TXT controls, file name input, auto-reset behavior, and TXT export with specific naming rules.
architectural_notes: Only modify the Cleaned Notes panel; do not remove existing formatting features.
Download TXT button should be hidden when Cleaned Output is empty.
Default download filename format: notes_<first_word_of_output>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.txt when File Name input is empty.

existing_features.title: Modify only the "Cleaned Notes" output panel in frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx to rebuild the action section layout as follows: (1) keep the existing Copy button directly below the "Cleaned Output" textarea, (2) add a new "Clear Output" button next to Copy (same row), (3) directly below that row render a "File Name" input with placeholder "Enter file name (optional)", and (4) directly below the File Name input render a "Download TXT" button. Ensure the layout is clean and responsive (stacking appropriately on small screens) and do not remove or change any existing formatting features/options.

Implement "Clear Output" behavior in frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: when clicked, completely clear the "Cleaned Output" textarea (cleanedNotes becomes empty), reset the File Name input value to empty, reset the Copy button state (so it is no longer in a "Copied!" state), and ensure the "Download TXT" button is hidden when the output is empty.

Implement auto-reset behavior when the "Clean Notes" button is clicked in frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: automatically clear any previous cleaned output and reset File Name and Copy state before displaying the newly formatted result, ensuring outputs do not stack/accumulate across runs.

Update TXT download logic to match the requested naming rules while preserving plain-text export: in frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownload.ts, when the File Name input is empty, generate the filename using the format notes_<first_word_of_output>_<current_date>.txt where <current_date> is YYYY-MM-DD. The <first_word_of_output> must come from the cleaned output text (ignoring leading whitespace and common bullet prefixes like "- ", "• ", "* "), sanitized for filenames (lowercase, spaces to underscores, remove non [a-z0-9_], collapse underscores). When a custom name is provided, use it and ensure it ends with .txt. The downloaded file must contain exactly the cleaned output as plain text, preserving spacing/newlines and containing no HTML tags.

new_feature_requests.summary: Rebuild Cleaned Notes action section: add File Name input, Clear Output button next to Copy, and Download TXT button below Copy; only modify Cleaned Notes panel and keep responsive layout.
Implement Clear Output behavior: clears Cleaned Output textarea, hides Download TXT when output empty, and resets File Name input.
Implement auto-reset on Clean Notes: clear previous Cleaned Output before showing new formatted result; do not stack outputs.
Implement Download TXT export: generate plain .txt preserving spacing/formatting with no HTML tags; filename uses custom input or default notes_<first_word_of_output>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.txt.

projectName: Rebuild Notes Cleaner output action section (Copy/Clear + File Name + Download TXT) with reset & filename rules
